title: TRIM_FACE payload
description: Remove the part of a face beyond its intersection line with a cutting face (v0.2 §13.5, E-08; spec §10.6 rule 7; D-322, D-323).

cuttingFaceId.description: Face G; the trim line is plane(F) ∩ plane(G), computed by the kernel (D-322).

keepPoint.description: A point on the part that stays (D-323).

$comment: `cuttingFaceId` replaces the free `trimLine` (D-322; schema change approved D-331, 3D-105).
